name: Do I need new plumbing and electrical lines for a walk-in tub?

mainEntity.name: Do I need new plumbing and electrical lines for a walk-in tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in tub installations almost always require electrical and plumbing adjustments. Standard bathtubs do not need power, but walk-in models with hydrotherapy jets, heated seating, or fast-drain pumps require dedicated electrical circuits with GFCI protection. Additionally, walk-in tubs often require larger rapid-fill valves and repositioned drain lines to prevent standing water. During project coordination, HH Remodeling manages licensed trade specialists to run dedicated wiring and adjust subfloor plumbing, while our crew handles the structural framing, subfloor prep, and restorative finish surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, walk-in tubs typically require dedicated electrical circuits for jets and pumps, along with modified plumbing lines to accommodate rapid fill and drain valves.
